briefdescription.para: Returns a basis of the initial ideal.

detaileddescription.para: Inserts a polynomial into the basis at index size() - or index size() - 1 after calling, since size() will increase by one. Lead monomials must be unique among basis elements.
Returns the index of a basis element whose lead term divides mon. Returns -1 if there is no such basis element.
As divisor(mon), but if there is more than one divisor then the divisor is chosen according to some notion of which reducer is better.
Replaces basis element at index with the given new polynomial. The lead term of the new polynomial must be the same as the previous one. This is useful for auto-tail-reduction.

briefdescription.para: Returns the number of basis elements, including retired elements.

detaileddescription.para: Returns a data structure containing the lead monomial of each basis element.
Retires the basis element at index, which returns ownership of the polynomial to the caller and frees most resources associated to that basis elements.
Returns an basis containing all non-retired basis elements and retires all those basis elements. The point of the simultaneous retirement is that this way no polynomials need be copied.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if the basis element at index has been retired.
Returns the basis element polynomial at index.
Returns the basis element polynomial at index.
Returns the lead monomial of poly(index).
Returns the lead coefficient of poly(index).

detaileddescription.para: Returns true if the leading monomial of the basis element at index is not divisible by the lead monomial of any other basis element. Lead monomials are required to be unique among basis elements, so the case of several equal lead monomials does not occur.
Returns true if the lead monomial of poly is not divisible by the lead monomial of any basis element. Equality counts as divisibility.

briefdescription.para: Returns the number of basis elements with minimal lead monomial.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the index of the basis element of maximal index whose lead monomial is minimal.

briefdescription.para: Returns the basis element polynomial at index.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the number of monomials across all the basis elements. Monomials that appear in more than one basis element are counted more than once.

briefdescription.para: Returns how many bytes has been allocated by this object.

detaileddescription.para: Stores a basis of polynomials. Designed for use in Groebner basis algorithms.
